## Description
A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Environment
- Component: (Backend / Mobile / Web / Infrastructure / Docs)
- Version / Commit SHA:
- Operating System / Device:
- Browser / App Version (if applicable):
- Society / Tenant Context:

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Perform action '...'
3. See error '...'

## Expected Behavior
What was expected to happen according to the SRS/business rules.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened.

## Logs / Screenshots
If applicable, add logs (ensure NO secrets or sensitive personal data are included) or screenshots.

## Severity
- [ ] Critical (Blocks core operations, security vulnerability, data corruption)
- [ ] High (Major feature impaired, no workaround)
- [ ] Medium (Feature impaired, workaround exists)
- [ ] Low (Cosmetic, minor inconvenience)

## Reproduction Status
- [ ] Consistently reproducible
- [ ] Intermittent
- [ ] Occurred once
